 MARVEL STUDIOS’ DIWALI GIFT TO INDIA! DOCTOR DOOM (ROBERT DOWNEY JR.), STEVE ROGERS (CHRIS EVANS) SEND SPECIAL WISHES TO FANS AS ‘AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY’ GETS EARLY RELEASE IN INDIA | 28 October, 2026
 By Film Information - October 28, 2026 
 Share 
 Facebook Pinterest Twitter WhatsApp 
 Avengers: Doomsday will release in India a day before the US, on 17th December, 2026, in English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu. 
 This Diwali, Marvel India is giving Indian fans a reason to celebrate like never before! With just 50 days to go until Avengers: Doomsday storms into cinemas, Hollywood superstars Robert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans, who play Doctor Doom and Steve Rogers respectively, have a special festive surprise for their Indian fans. In an exclusive video message, the two iconic stars have extended their Diwali wishes to the audience across the country, adding to the unprecedented excitement surrounding one of the most anticipated cinematic spectacles of the year. And the celebrations don’t end there! Avengers: Doomsday is all set to release in Indian cinemas a day ahead of the US, giving Indian audiences the opportunity to witness the epic showdown before the US. 
 With excitement already reaching fever pitch, this double Diwali surprise is set to take Marvel mania in India to a whole new level, fuelling an extraordinary wave of anticipation and setting the stage for one of the biggest cinematic showdowns the country has witnessed. 
 In the video message, RDJ and Evans shared, “Namaste, India! What we love about Diwali is, it marks the closing of one chapter and beginning of another… that’s something we know a lot about, except instead of moving from dark to light, I think, it might be going in the other direction. Happy Diwali and we will see you in Avengers: Doomsday ! You bet!” 
 In Avengers: Doomsday , heroes from three distinct universes will be set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat, unlike anything they’ve ever encountered. The film is directed by Anthony and Joe Russo; produced by Kevin Feige, Louis D’Esposito and Jonathan Schwartz; and stars Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Pedro Pascal, Paul Rudd, Anthony Mackie, Florence Pugh, Vanessa Kirby, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Wyatt Russell, Channing Tatum, Simu Liu, Ian McKellen, Hayley Atwell, Tom Hiddleston, James Marsden, Patrick Stewart, Joseph Quinn, Sebastian Stan, David Harbour, Letitia Wright, Lewis Pullman, Kelsey Grammer, Kathryn Newton, Danny Ramirez, Winston Duke, Alan Cumming, Hannah John-Kamen, Rebecca Romijn, Alex Livinalli, Mabel Cadena, with Tenoch Huerta Mejia. 
 Avengers: Doomsday will be available in Infinity Vision and other premium formats.
